sloka: स तम् आश्वासयत् रामो वालिनम् व्यक्त दर्शनम् ।साधु सम्मतया वाचा धर्म तत्त्वार्त्ध युक्तया ॥४-१८-५९॥
transliteration: sa tam āśvāsayat rāmo vālinam vyakta darśanam ।sādhu sammatayā vācā dharma tattvārtdha yuktayā ॥4-18-59॥

translations.english: 'Even though I was prevented by Tara, I came for a duel with Sugriva since I wished to die in your hands.' Having spoken thus to Rama, Vali fell silent.
